offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty commercial property and casualty insurance for businesses, along with annuities sold to individuals, and provides equipment leasing and financing to businesses. Sells mainly through independent agents and brokers, and annuities also through banks and financial partners.

primary_products.value: specialty commercial insurance policies; crop insurance; fixed and variable annuities

primary_services.value: equipment leasing and financing; insurance claims handling

customer_segment.value: B2B: businesses across transportation, agriculture, construction and other specialty commercial sectors; B2C: individuals buying retirement annuities

end_markets.value: insurance; agriculture; transportation; construction; retirement savings

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: insurance premiums from policyholders and investment income on invested assets; rental or leasing: equipment leases and loans to business customers
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; rental or leasing

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in premiums and deposits from businesses and individuals and pays claims and annuity benefits; service provider: handles claims and underwriting for insured commercial and agricultural customers

geography_served.value: US national: Writes insurance and sells annuities across all US states, with some international specialty business

specialization.value: diversified: Separate businesses: specialty commercial property and casualty insurance, annuities, and equipment leasing and financing

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents and brokers placing commercial policies; partners / resellers: banks and broker-dealers selling annuity products

regulatory_exposure.value: high: Insurance and annuity businesses require state insurance licenses and are regulated by state insurance departments

notes: Exact segment mix and product lines may have changed; details are a general description.
divestiture_lines: P2.9: Sale of Commercial Lines Division
P2.15: Sale of long-term care business
P2.21: Sale of Annuity Business to MassMutual
